mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_template (id, course_id, template_name, description, owner_id, status) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{template.id}), HEXTORAW(#{template.courseId}), #{template.templateName}, #{template.description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HEXTORAW(#{template.ownerId}), #{template.status})
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(t.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(t.course_id) AS courseId, t.template_name AS templateName, t.description, RAWTOHEX(t.owner_id) AS ownerId, RAWTOHEX(t.current_version_id) AS currentVersionId, t.status FROM edudoc_template t WHERE t.id = HEXTORAW(#{templateId})
mapper.sql: SELECT RAWTOHEX(t.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(t.course_id) AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, t.template_name AS templateName, t.description, RAWTOHEX(t.owner_id) AS ownerId, t.status, RAWTOHEX(t.current_version_id) AS currentVersionId, cv.version_no AS currentVersionNo, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_format_rule r WHERE r.template_version_id = t.current_version_id) AS ruleCount, TO_CHAR(t.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createTime, TO_CHAR(t.update_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS updateTime FROM edudoc_template t LEFT JOIN edudoc_course c ON c.id = t.course_id LEFT JOIN edudoc_template_version cv ON cv.id = t.current_version_id

mapper.update: UPDATE edudoc_template SET status = #{status} WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{templateId})
UPDATE edudoc_template SET current_version_id = HEXTORAW(#{versionId}) WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{templateId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM edudoc_template t WHERE t.id = HEXTORAW(#{templateId}) AND t.status = 'D' AND t.current_version_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edudoc_template_version v WHERE v.template_id = t.id)
